data.title: Mobile Developer
data.summary: Develops iOS and Android applications, including digital identity, wallet, credential and mobile security features. The assignment is mostly remote within Finland.

requirements.text: Five years of mobile app development; both iOS and Android preferred
requirements.question: Would someone who has done mobile application development, with fewer than 5 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting makes extensive mobile development experience a mandatory screening criterion.

requirements.text: Experience from at least five completed iOS and Android mobile projects
Experience with digital identity, eID, mobile wallets or digital credentials
Experience implementing mobile device security features

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires fluent spoken and written Finnish for this otherwise mostly remote assignment.
